clue.text: Flag in all the colours of the rainbow

definitions.meaning: a flag is a plant of the wild yellow kind, also called a fleur-de-lis plant

definitions.text: all the colours of the rainbow
definitions.meaning: the Greek goddess of the rainbow, whose name is used for anything showing rainbow colours

explanation.definitionFit: The yellow flag is a species of that garden plant, and the goddess personified the rainbow, so an iridescent thing shows its colours.

clue.text: Line up the knot

indicators.note: in a down clue, up means the word for a line is read from bottom to top

parts.note: a rank is a line of soldiers

explanation.surface: An order to get people queuing up at a knot.
explanation.walkthrough: 'up' turns RANK round to give KNAR.
explanation.definitionFit: A knar is a gnarled knot in wood, a burr on a tree trunk.

clue.text: A petition framed in simple and straightforward language

indicators.note: the letters sit framed inside the words simple and, straddling the gap between them

explanation.surface: Advice that a petition should be written in plain, direct words.
explanation.definitionFit: A plea is an earnest request or appeal, a kind of petition.

clue.text: Taking issue about covering the cheese

indicators.note: about means one piece goes round the other, here the word for issue placed around the second

parts.note: issue means offspring, such as a son
a tilt is a canvas cover or awning over a cart or stall

explanation.surface: Someone disputing how a cheese should be wrapped.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Taking' is a link. TILT, now rare, is a canvas awning over a cart. STILTON is a blue English cheese from the Midlands.
explanation.definitionFit: Stilton is a famous blue-veined English cheese from the Midlands.

clue.text: Jokes may be cracked if peers lag

indicators.note: cracking something breaks it up, so these words are broken and rearranged

explanation.surface: Lords who are slow to catch on might still crack a joke.
explanation.walkthrough: 'may be cracked' asks for IF PEERS LAG to be rearranged.
explanation.definitionFit: Persiflage is light, frivolous banter, a stream of jokes and teasing.

clue.text: Bless thee, Bottom! bless thee! thou art ——" (Shakespeare: A Midsummer Night's Dream)

definitions.text: Bless thee, Bottom! bless thee! thou art

parts.words: Bless thee, Bottom! bless thee! thou art
parts.note: Peter Quince's line on seeing Bottom with an ass's head: the missing word says he has been transformed

explanation.walkthrough: A fill-in-the-blank quotation: Quince cries out on seeing Bottom with an ass's head in place of his own.
explanation.definitionFit: In the play's older sense the word means changed or transformed, as Bottom is given a donkey's head.

clue.text: An impressive device that requires daily adjustment

definitions.text: An impressive device that requires daily adjustment

parts.words: An impressive device that requires daily adjustment
parts.note: impressive puns on making an impression, as an inked rubber stamp does, and the setting is changed every day

explanation.definitionFit: This office tool prints the day's calendar details by pressing an inked mark onto paper.

clue.text: Understand dunderhead's offspring

parts.note: to see is to understand, as in 'I see'
the head of the word dunder is its first letter, D

explanation.surface: Grasping what a fool's children are like.
explanation.walkthrough: 'dunderhead' is split as the head of 'dunder', giving D.
explanation.definitionFit: Seed is an old word for descendants or progeny, as in the biblical 'thy seed'.

clue.text: Short in support, which is most surprising

indicators.note: in says the word for short is placed inside the word for support

parts.note: a sling is a support for an injured arm
tart means short or sharp in manner, as a tart reply is a curt one

explanation.surface: A brief rest in a brace, which is quite a surprise.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Short' is not a length here but a manner: tart, curt.
explanation.definitionFit: Startling means astonishing, alarming by being unexpected.

clue.text: A thousand and fifty in the road have got running water

indicators.note: in means these letters go inside the word for the road

parts.note: a street is a road
M is the Roman numeral for a thousand
L is the Roman numeral for fifty

explanation.surface: A flood in the street, a thousand and fifty litres of running water.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' puts AML inside STREET, between its two Es.
explanation.definitionFit: A streamlet is a small stream, a little flow of running water.

clue.text: The bad character seldom seen nowadays

indicators.note: bad suggests the word is spoilt, so its letters are jumbled

explanation.surface: A villain who rarely appears these days.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bad' rearranges THE. 'character' is a letter, not a villain: the old English letter for a th sound.
explanation.definitionFit: Eth is an Old English letter for the th sound, now used only in Icelandic and phonetics.

clue.text: Over and above a pound's nothing

parts.note: L is the abbreviation for a pound sterling, with the 's added
O is nought, nothing

explanation.surface: A complaint that a pound is now worth nothing more.
explanation.definitionFit: Also means in addition, besides, as over and above does.

clue.text: Do wrong with little hesitation, right?

parts.note: er is the small sound of hesitating

explanation.surface: Someone checking whether a slight pause was a mistake.
explanation.definitionFit: To err is to make a mistake, to go astray.

clue.text: Just rise, tough to negotiate

indicators.note: negotiating is working things round, so these letters are worked into a new order

explanation.surface: A pay rise that is hard to agree.
explanation.definitionFit: Righteous means morally right, fair and upright, as a just person is.

clue.text: Calls to mind touching prayers

parts.note: re means concerning, touching on
collects are short prayers in church liturgy

explanation.surface: Moving prayers bring memories back.
explanation.definitionFit: To recollect is to remember, bringing something back into memory.

clue.text: A stone of additional vegetables first

indicators.note: first says the vegetables piece goes at the front, before the word for additional

parts.note: greens are green vegetables such as cabbage
and adds one thing to another

explanation.surface: Extra vegetables served before something hard.
explanation.definitionFit: Greensand is a greenish sandstone rock, coloured by the mineral glauconite.

clue.text: Cutting rent arranged with church worker

indicators.note: arranged means put into a new order, so these letters are rearranged

parts.note: an ant is the classic worker in crosswords

explanation.surface: A church worker sets a cut in the rent.
explanation.definitionFit: Trenchant means incisive and sharp, as a cutting remark is.

clue.text: Dispute backing it-very loudly

indicators.note: backing means going in reverse, so the little word is read the other way

parts.note: ff, fortissimo, is the musical direction for very loud

explanation.surface: A row that someone backs very loudly.
explanation.definitionFit: A tiff is a petty quarrel, a small argument.

clue.text: A couple of hundred deer may be dispersed, he agrees

parts.note: C is the Roman numeral for a hundred, two of them CC

indicators.note: dispersing scatters things, so these letters are scattered and reformed

explanation.surface: Two hundred deer scattered across a hillside.
explanation.walkthrough: 'may be dispersed' rearranges DEER to EDER.
explanation.definitionFit: One who accedes is someone who consents or assents to a request.

clue.text: Stock letter

definitions.meaning: stock is money invested in a business
an upper-case letter at the start of a sentence

explanation.definitionFit: Capital means a firm's funds or wealth, and also a large initial letter such as A rather than a.

clue.text: Seriously overweight associate

parts.note: fat means overweight
an ally is an associate or partner

explanation.surface: A heavy partner.
explanation.definitionFit: Fatally means mortally, in a way causing death, a serious injury.

clue.text: The Spanish article showing spirit

parts.note: el is the Spanish word for the
an is the indefinite article

explanation.surface: A Spanish piece of writing full of life.
explanation.definitionFit: Elan is vigour, flair and enthusiasm, a kind of spirit.

clue.text: Mock suffering, so it's said, and drink

indicators.note: so it's said signals that the words are spoken, giving the sound of another word

parts.note: sham means mock, false, and pain means suffering

explanation.surface: Pretending to be in agony and then having a glass.
explanation.walkthrough: SHAM PAIN, said out loud, sounds like the French sparkling wine.
explanation.definitionFit: Champagne is a sparkling wine, a celebratory drink.

clue.text: A move made in the past

parts.note: a go is a turn or move in a game

explanation.surface: A chess move made long ago.
explanation.definitionFit: Ago means before now, earlier.

clue.text: Note some have chosen to return

indicators.note: to return means go back, so the letters are read backwards
some means just part of the word chosen is taken

explanation.surface: A remark that some people have decided to come back.
explanation.walkthrough: 'some' takes HOS from 'chosen'; 'to return' turns it into SOH, the fifth note of the sol-fa scale.
explanation.definitionFit: Soh is the fifth note of the tonic sol-fa scale.

clue.text: A divine woman as portrayed by a male artist

parts.note: he is the male pronoun
RA is a Royal Academician, an artist

explanation.surface: A goddess painted by a man.
explanation.definitionFit: Hera is the Greek goddess, queen of the gods and wife of Zeus.

clue.text: Left a party upon a top journalist's appearance

parts.note: a band is a party or group of people
on means upon
ED, editor, is the top journalist on a paper

explanation.surface: Leaving a party when the editor turns up.
explanation.definitionFit: Abandoned means deserted, left behind.

clue.text: Grim, causing many great displeasure

parts.note: D is the Roman numeral 500, a large number
ire is anger

explanation.surface: Something gloomy that annoys lots of people.
explanation.definitionFit: Dire means dreadful, terrible, bleak.

clue.text: Record a bit of music

explanation.definitionFit: To note is to jot down, and a single sound in a tune is also called that.

clue.text: Only a little slump

explanation.definitionFit: A drop is a tiny amount, as in a drop of milk, and also a fall, as in a drop in prices.

clue.text: A boss endlessly reading

indicators.note: endlessly means the last letter of the word for reading is lost

parts.note: study means reading, as in book study

explanation.surface: A manager who never stops reading.
explanation.walkthrough: 'endlessly' drops the last letter of STUDY.
explanation.definitionFit: A stud is a raised boss, an ornamental knob on a surface.

clue.text: Allowance made to relation possibly

indicators.note: possibly means the letters may be put in another order

explanation.surface: Allowances made for a family member.
explanation.walkthrough: 'possibly' rearranges RELATION to LERATION, after TO as written.
explanation.definitionFit: Toleration is the act of permitting, putting up with something.
